verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API (POST /v1/document_sets, form retrieval, JSON submission, state polling) that could drive formation workflows programmatically. However, authentication is still "coming soon" and uses an interactive OAuth authorization-code flow with user redirect and sign-in, which does not suit unattended CI. The live MCP server is OAuth-gated, read-only, and aimed at chat assistants rather than headless pipelines. missing for 10: launched/usable API auth, non-interactive service tokens or API keys for CI, CLI or SDK for headless runs, write-capable automation beyond partner formation flows, independent hands-on corroboration.
